candidate_reachability_supplement.interpretation: Post-formal conservative diagnostic. It compares the complete Branch B refined candidate pool against the complete shared-state candidate pool at matched K. It cannot alter the predeclared gates.

gates.decision: INDEPENDENT_STATE_FAIL: the frozen independent-state branch does not satisfy the capacity-matched statistical and mechanistic gates. Close the temporal multi-state route; do not train or read DAVIS.
